description: Source code for a Bluetooth central device using Zephyr RTOS, implementing encrypted advertising data handling, device scanning, connection management, GATT service discovery, and security procedures.

methods.name: data_parse_cb
methods.description: Callback to parse received Bluetooth data, decrypt encrypted data, and accumulate parsed data size.

methods.name: device_found
methods.description: Handler invoked when a device is found during scanning; processes advertisement data if device matches peer address.

methods.name: connect_device_found
methods.description: Handler invoked when a device is found; initiates connection if device is in close range.

methods.name: start_scan
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth scanning, optionally connecting to found devices.

methods.name: gatt_read_cb
methods.description: Callback for GATT read responses, copies data into buffer and signals completion.

methods.name: gatt_read
methods.description: Performs GATT read operations over specified handle range and UUID.

methods.name: gatt_discover_cb
methods.description: Callback for GATT service discovery, captures start and end handles.

methods.name: gatt_discover_primary_service
methods.description: Discovers primary GATT service of specified type.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth connection event; manages connection state and retries.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth disconnection event; cleans up connection state.

methods.name: identity_resolved
methods.description: Handles identity resolution for privacy features.

methods.name: init_bt
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth subsystem and registers callbacks.

methods.name: run_central_sample
methods.description: Main function to run the Bluetooth central sample, managing scanning, connection, security, service discovery, and data exchange.
